rationale.ubuntu: Linux ext4/xfs with kernel page caching provides near-instantaneous git process spawns and file unlinking.
rationale.macos: APFS provides copy-on-write clonefile acceleration but exhibits higher process creation latency than Linux.
rationale.windows: NTFS filesystem filter drivers, mandatory handle locking semantics, and real-time antivirus (e.g. Windows Defender) file-system interception introduce significant variable jitter on rapid consecutive git.exe process spawning and worktree cleanup, requiring a wider 100% duration tolerance.
